item.description: Lesson 2: Planning an App — From Idea to a Buildable Specification Good apps start on paper, not in code. item.title: Designing for Small Screens — Layout, Navigation, and Accessibility
item.description: Lesson 3: Designing for Small Screens — Layout, Navigation, and Accessibility Designing for a phone is not shrinking a desktop design; it is designing for a different way of using software. People use phones in short bursts, often one-handed, in bright light, on the move, and with interruptions.…

item.title: Working with Data — Storage, Networks, and Offline Behaviour
item.description: Lesson 5: Working with Data — Storage, Networks, and Offline Behaviour Most useful apps need data that lives beyond a single screen: saved notes, user accounts, product lists, bookings, or messages.
